intro.text: The Open Finance Insurance Data Sharing capabilities let your LFI expose a customer’s policy data to consented TPPs across the UAE’s major insurance sectors. Implementation mirrors Bank Data Sharing: the API Hub validates consent, proxies requests to your Ozone Connect server, and returns the response to the TPP.

blocks.text: Access to the Insurance Data Sharing APIs requires TPPs to hold the ISP role. The API Hub validates the role on every request before proxying it to your Ozone Connect endpoints.
Implement the endpoint pair for each insurance sector your LFI underwrites. The Hub routes requests by path; sectors you do not offer simply remain unmounted.
The full set of pages for the Insurance Data Sharing API on the LFI side.
Validation rules and behaviour your Ozone Connect endpoints must follow.
How your Ozone Connect server receives, processes, and responds to Insurance Data Sharing requests proxied by the API Hub.
The end-to-end customer flow when sharing insurance data — from the TPP consent screen through your LFI’s authorisation pages and back.
OpenAPI reference for the Ozone Connect endpoint.
